title: sabulina cismontana
intro: Sabulina cismontana, commonly known as Silene acaulis ssp. cismontana, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the pink purslane family (Sileneaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Sabulina cismontana include its ability to act as an adaptogen and a nervine, helping to balance the body's response to stress and promote a sense of calm. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
